methods.label: Count complete cycles and convert to miles
methods.explanation:
Each rollover represents \(100000\) steps: after reaching \(99999\), one more step returns the display to \(00000\). Thus the forty-four rollovers account for forty-four complete blocks of \(100000\) steps, and the final reading adds another \(50000\) steps. Pete's total is
\[
44\cdot100000+50000=4450000\text{ steps}.
\]
Since each mile takes \(1800\) steps, he walked
\[
\frac{4450000}{1800}=\frac{22250}{9}\approx2472.2\text{ miles}.
\]
This is below \(2500\), the smallest answer choice, so every larger choice is farther away. The closest distance is \(\boxed{2500}\) miles, choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
